exposure: microbiota composition (alpha diversity, abundance of Bacteroides, Akkermansia, Coprococcus, Ruminococcus)
cohort: The study included 25 mestizo children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (cases) and 35 matched controls without ASD from Ecuador, matched by age, sex, and school location.
finding: Children with ASD had a higher prevalence of under- and overweight, abnormal food habits, more frequent gastrointestinal symptoms, greater serum concentrations of TGF-b1, and distinct gut microbiota composition characterized by greater alpha diversity and abundance of specific bacteria (Bacteroides, Akkermansia, Coprococcus, Ruminococcus).
